name: Fomalhaut
source:
“I will reclaim everything and begin anew.
Pure wishes, blazing convictions—I'll shatter them all.
Nothing in this world could ever hope to balance the scales.”

Unit: Offense Black, 1st Squad
Rank: Space

A prodigy said to embody the very hope of humanity.
With unparalleled talent and an overwhelming wish, he becomes the mastermind who initiates an invasion of the real world in order to reset everything.

He venerates humanity itself, placing it above all else.

Class: Realist
Reality-Altering Ability: Glory of Humanity — an ability that wields the accumulated wisdom of mankind. With his extraordinary capacity, nothing is impossible.
